data.name: Usage
data.value:
Usage: Common options: [--culture <name>] [--log <Trace|Debug|Information|Warning|Error>] e.g. --culture ja-JP / --log Debug (Core's diagnostic log to stderr)
UiaTrigger.TestHost [monitor] [--file <path>] [--duration <sec>] UiaTrigger.TestHost record <id> [--file <path>] [--delay <sec>] [--point <x>,<y>] [--on ElementAppeared|ElementRemoved|PropertyChanged|WhileMatching] [--prop Name|AutomationId|ClassName|ControlType|BoundingRectangle|AccessKey| AcceleratorKey|HelpText|IsEnabled|IsOffscreen|Value|RangeValue| RangeValueMinimum|RangeValueMaximum] [--op Always|Equals|NotEquals|Between|NotBetween|GreaterThan|LessThan| LessOrEqual|GreaterOrEqual|RegexMatch|RegexNotMatch] [--value <num>] [--low <num>] [--high <num>] [--text <str>] [--tolerance <num>] [--min-interval <sec>] [--poll-interval <sec>] [--view Raw|Control|Content]
--poll-interval is the way out when the target application raises no UIA notifications, so nothing ever fires. Disabled by default: monitoring is event-driven. The PollCount / PolledReadCount printed on exit show what it costs, and tell you whether "nothing fired" means "nothing was polled".
data.comment: The whole usage block. Keep the option names untranslated - they are typed on the command line.
